title: Duration
description: A length of time as an ISO 8601 duration (RFC 3339 Appendix A grammar) with whole-number components greater than zero: weeks alone, or years, months, and days in that order, optionally followed by `T` and hours, minutes, and seconds in that order, each at most once (e.g., `P30D` is 30 days, `PT30M` is 30 minutes, `P1M` is one month; `T` separates date units from time units, so `M` before it means months and after it minutes). It states a length, not an instant; resolving it to a calendar time is up to the schema that uses it.
